verdict.seen: A black tyre on a stand with a small orange block sitting above the tyre top and a white marker moving around the rim. The block does not clearly touch the tyre.
verdict.problem: The orange block hovers above the tyre rather than pressing onto it, so no braking contact is shown; lower the block until it visibly presses on the tread.

verdict.seen: A tyre with an orange block on top and a faint grey blob in the air near the wall. No clear smoke pours from the contact point.
verdict.problem: The smoke is a faint grey blob floating away from the tyre and block, not pouring off the contact; spawn dark smoke puffs at the block-tyre contact.

verdict.seen: A steel disc with bolt holes appears on the hub, a red caliper sits over it, and the orange block sits above the tyre, lifted off.
The speed sign reads 60 in all frames while the disc with red caliper keeps spinning, with a TOO WEAK label.
A pedal on a base and a master cylinder appear, and an orange pipe with fluid dots runs to the red caliper on the disc.
A close-up of the disc with the red caliper surrounded by a glowing yellow outline, with the pipe visible.
The pedal swings down, the fluid pipe is present, the caliper clamps and the speed sign drops from 60 to 0.
The disc changes from grey to a red-pink glow across the frames, with a heat gauge beside the speed sign.
Slots open in the orange-hot disc, and the colour fades from orange to pale pink while white air arrows pass the rim.
The speed sign shows 100 then 500, and the heat gauge turns from green to orange-red.
A brake light post with a glowing red lamp appears on the base at the left of the pedal, standing on the base plate.
The whole finished disc brake with pedal, pipe, caliper and brake light is in view as the camera pulls back, with nothing covering it.
